description: A rare burst of courage from a timid wisp. When a vulnerable enemy is exposed, the wisp darts forward in a quick frost-charged rush, delivering a light disruptive strike before instantly retreating to safety. The attack deals minor frost damage, inflicts frostbite and silence, and triggers a brief revenge pulse, but the wisp avoids staying in danger by backstepping the full distance of its charge.
name: Astral Wisp Ambush
